svg.metadata: {"title":"Large update, saved in batches","speed":2200,"elements":[{"id":"root","type":"group","children":["agent","retain","store"],"layout":{"direction":"row","gap":56,"align":"center"}},{"id":"agent","type":"rectangle","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Append"},{"type":"subtitle","text":"new turn: 1,061 chunks to extract"}]},{"id":"retain","type":"rectangle","tone":"blue","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Update retain"},{"type":"subtitle","text":"extract changed chunks"}]},{"id":"store","type":"group","label":{"title":"Document"},"children":["chunks","doc"],"layout":{"direction":"column","gap":28,"align":"stretch"}},{"id":"chunks","type":"cylinder","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Chunks + facts"}]},{"id":"doc","type":"cylinder","content":[{"type":"title","text":"Document text"}]},{"id":"call","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"agent"},"end":{"id":"retain"},"label":{"text":"retain"}},{"id":"save","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"retain"},"end":{"id":"chunks"},"label":{"text":"save"}},{"id":"move","type":"arrow","route":"curved","start":{"id":"retain"},"end":{"id":"doc"},"label":{"text":"new text"},"quiet":true}],"scenes":[{"label":"Before","beats":[{"edges":"call","say":"Before: every missing chunk is extracted in one step."},{"light":["retain"],"show":{"retain":[{"tag":"LLM","tone":"gray","text":"1,060 chunks extracted","meta":"nothing saved yet"}]},"say":"Nothing is saved until the very end."},{"light":["retain"],"show":{"retain":[{"tag":"timeout","tone":"red","text":"1 h limit hit","mark":"✗"}],"chunks":[{"tone":"gray","text":"928 chunks","meta":"unchanged"}]},"say":"A timeout throws it all away. The next append starts from zero."}]},{"label":"After","beats":[{"edges":"call","say":"After: the same work is split into batches of 100."},{"edges":"save","show":{"chunks":[{"tag":"batch 1","tone":"green","text":"100 chunks","mark":"saved"}]},"say":"Each batch saves its chunks and facts as soon as it is extracted."},{"edges":"save","show":{"chunks":[{"tag":"batch 1","tone":"green","text":"100 chunks","mark":"saved"},{"tag":"batch 2","tone":"green","text":"100 chunks","mark":"saved"}],"doc":[{"tone":"gray","text":"old text","meta":"until the last batch"}]},"say":"The document keeps its old text, so a retry plans against the same base."},{"light":["retain"],"show":{"retain":[{"tag":"retry","tone":"blue","text":"skips 200 saved chunks","mark":"↻"}]},"say":"Interrupted? The retry sees the saved chunks and skips them."},{"edges":"move","show":{"doc":[{"tone":"green","text":"new text","mark":"new"}]},"say":"Only the last batch moves the document to its new text."}]}]}
